rationale: Parth brings hands-on hardware testing expertise from Tesla's humanoid robotics program, while AJ is building dexterous robotic systems at Seed Physical with deep knowledge of hardware-software co-design. They share core robotics domains and AJ has explicitly signaled openness to discussing robotics engineering approaches—making this a natural conversation for exploring practical manipulation challenges and testing methodologies.
intro_message: Parth Behani, meet AJ Chahal — Parth's experience testing humanoid robot hardware at Tesla could offer valuable perspective on the real-world validation challenges AJ is solving with dexterous manipulation systems at Seed Physical.
